items.title: Drupal Warns of Fast Exploitation Risk for Critical Core RCE Flaw
items.summary: Critical flaws impact the Entity List and Field UI modules, and exploit paths exist with contributed modules. The post Drupal Warns of Fast Exploitation Risk for Critical Core RCE Flaw appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: Drupal 警告核心重大 RCE 漏洞面臨快速利用風險
items.summary_zh: 重大漏洞影響了 Entity List 和 Field UI 模組，且第三方社群模組（contributed modules）中存在利用路徑。Drupal 警告核心重大 RCE 漏洞面臨快速利用風險的文章首次出現在 SecurityWeek。

items.title: F5 releases out-of-band patches for critical NGINX vulnerabilities
items.summary: F5 has released out-of-band security patches to address multiple NGINX web server flaws, including three critical-severity vulnerabilities that can let attackers execute code on vulnerable systems. [...]
items.title_zh: F5 為 NGINX 重大漏洞發布帶外修補程式
items.summary_zh: F5 已發布帶外（out-of-band）安全修補程式，以修復多個 NGINX 網頁伺服器漏洞，其中包括三個嚴重程度為重大的漏洞，可能允許攻擊者在受影響的系統上執行程式碼。[...]

items.title: Critical BlockStrap flaw lets hackers run code on Magento servers
items.summary: Researchers warn that hackers could soon exploit a maximum-severity vulnerability (CVE-2026-103849) affecting Magento and Adobe Commerce, potentially allowing them to execute arbitrary PHP code on store servers. [...]
items.title_zh: BlockStrap 嚴重漏洞允許駭客在 Magento 伺服器上執行程式碼
items.summary_zh: 研究人員警告，駭客可能很快就會利用影響 Magento 和 Adobe Commerce 的最高嚴重程度漏洞（CVE-2026-103849），潛在允許他們在商店伺服器上執行任意 PHP 程式碼。[...]

items.summary_zh: CISA 已獲悉影響 BeyondTrust Remote Support（前身為 Bomgar）26.2.3 及更早版本的嚴重身份驗證旁路漏洞 CVE-2026-102764。受支援的版本（24.3.1 及更高版本）已有修補程式可用；使用較舊版本的組織必須先進行升級。網路威脅入侵者正在活躍利用該漏洞以取得初始存取權限……

items.title: WordPress SEO plugin Rank Math compromised to backdoor websites
items.summary: Some downloads of the Rank Math PRO WordPress plugin from the vendor's official website carried malware that planted hidden backdoors in a supply-chain attack last week. [...]
items.title_zh: WordPress SEO 外掛 Rank Math 遭入侵以植入後門網站
items.summary_zh: 上週在一場供應鏈攻擊中，從廠商官方網站下載的部分 Rank Math PRO WordPress 外掛軟體帶有惡意軟體，會植入隱藏的後門。[...]

items.title: Rank Math PRO WordPress Plugin Compromised in Supply Chain Attack
items.summary: Hackers injected malware into Rank Math PRO version 3.0.123 packages distributed between October 15 and October 16. The post Rank Math PRO WordPress Plugin Compromised in Supply Chain Attack appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: Rank Math PRO WordPress 外掛於供應鏈攻擊中遭入侵
items.summary_zh: 黑客在 10 月 15 日至 10 月 16 日期間分發的 Rank Math PRO 3.0.123 版本套件中注入了惡意軟體。Rank Math PRO WordPress 外掛於供應鏈攻擊中遭入侵的文章首次出現在 SecurityWeek。

items.title: Nikkei discloses third data breach in a month, 1.8M records exposed
items.summary: Nikkei Inc. disclosed a new data breach, the third in about a month, that exposed 1.83 million personal information records. [...]
items.title_zh: 日經公開一個月內第三起資料外洩事件，180 萬筆記錄遭曝光
